Position reporting with unlinked LRBG compliant balise group when linking check is disabled, steps 1-2
Acceptance of trackside information referring to the 8th last reported LRBG, step 1

invented: Test 'Acceptance of trackside information referring to the 9th last reported LRBG' expects the OBU to reject the message for a reference outside the 8 most recent LRBGs; the requirement states only a minimum, not rejection.
Rejection test expects the LRBG to be 'unknown' per 3.6.2.2.2.1, a section the requirement does not cite, and the expected result is hedged.
Position report triggers (standstill, periodic timer) are not stated in the requirement.
Test 'Position reporting after passing LRBG compliant balise group with message content processing' adds a rule that the report is sent only after the message content has been taken into account.
